prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Sentinel Vale EO ground segment. Security: least privilege, strong auth, segmentation, audit. Mission Control Center (MCC, Bluebell): real-time ops, anomaly response, releases validated commands, owns contact schedule/routing; elevated access needs approved shift role+time-limited need; sends constraints to MPS; escalation lead→discipline lead→mission mgmt; declares continuity modes (records objective, duration, exit criteria). Modes: monitor-only (no command release, telemetry where safe, protect evidence); essential-service (safety contacts, time-critical telemetry, core orbit support, protect unrecoverable payload data). Flight Dynamics Facility (FDF, Mistral): ephemerides/events to MCC, MPS, PPF; Star Tracker Mask File; Ephemeris Delta Note (MPS applies in schedule validation); maneuver recs to Spacecraft Operations Team (SOT); geometry to Payload Calibration Team (PCT); Orbit Determination Engine. Payload Processing Facility (PPF, Forgehouse): Primary/Backup Processing Clusters; Backup transfer only after custody, software baseline, operator authorization verified; Backup checks Storage Watermark Snapshot capacity before standby duty; both down→suspend, stage raw, notify MCC; quarantines unproven-lineage data. Telemetry Ingest Service; Pass Replay Packet (SOT); L0–L2. PCT owns calibration baseline. Product Quality Service: flags, Product Hold List (User Services Portal blocks release until hold cleared). Long Term Archive (Granite): authoritative custody; admits after PPF package+quality metadata+checksum; Storage Watermark Snapshot; preserves archive baseline, retrieval tests before stable ops. User Services Portal: versioned contracts; no speculative root cause before incident lead approval. Cybersecurity Desk. Network Control System (Lantern): routing, Security Exception Ticket. Mission Planning System (MPS, Cedar): command package to MCC. Command Validation Gateway (Osprey): mask checks; rejects commands lacking authorization state, validation result, operator acknowledgment. Ground Network Manager: cross-site failover; antennas North S-Band, South S-Band, Kiruna X-Band, Svalbard X-Band; accepts readiness only with current maintenance clearances. Triage: preserve evidence before restarts, write-protected case storage. Readiness review board: open actions need owner, due date, residual risk. Rehearsals: MCC console coverage/handover logs; FDF planning cycle; PPF sustained processing; Lantern outage/restoration; SOT

New part:
S244: Operational key performance indicators include contact success rate, telemetry completeness, command validation timeliness, product latency, product quality disposition time, archive availability, help desk responsiveness, and unresolved anomaly age.
S245: Each key performance indicator has an assigned data source, sampling interval, review owner, threshold, and corrective action trigger so that routine reporting does not depend on informal judgment.
S246: The primary monthly service review compares actual performance against the accepted baseline and records trend explanations for any measure that moves outside the watch band.
S247: The Primary Processing Cluster and Backup Processing Cluster are baselined with approved software versions, processing configurations, capacity reservations, monitoring checks, and rollback instructions before handover.
S248: Configuration baselines for ground software, operational procedures, interface control data, account roles, and monitoring rules are frozen at readiness review entry and changed only through approved change control.
S249: Handover to routine mission service is authorized when acceptance evidence is complete, rehearsals meet their objectives, open risks are acknowledged by accountable owners, and support teams confirm on-call coverage.
S250: After handover, the first operational reporting cycle is treated as a stabilization period in which deviations are reviewed daily and permanent process changes are deferred until sufficient evidence is available.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
